subject: Temporary keep request — purge gateway activation for Medinova data
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@medinova.health>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Ng <tng@medinova.health>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Temporary keep needed — investigation open

Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

We just received notice from our compliance team that Medinova is subject to a regulatory inquiry that requires temporary preservation of a narrow set of user records and related logs. We need Redwood to pause any scheduled backup purges and prevent deletion for the following dataset IDs: MED-acc-9b2f, MED-acc-9b3a, and the associated KV log buckets created between 2028-05-01 and 2028-07-15.

Attached is the completed temporary keep request form (medinova_temp_keep_form.pdf) with the legal contact (Tom Ng) and a high-level justification. Per our contract (DPA section 6.3), we expect Redwood to apply a short-term hold while we work through the inquiry. Can you confirm what evidence you need from our side (subprocessor receipts, custody chain, etc.) and how quickly you can flip a hold at the backup layer?

We appreciate a same-business-day acknowledgement.

Thanks,
Sarah Bennett
Data Privacy Lead
Medinova Health

--

- Hold purge for datasets MED-acc-9b2f, MED-acc-9b3a and log buckets matching 2028-05-01..2028-07-15.

Laura: can you scope the ops work and ETA to flip the hold? If we need CloudVault (their backup subproc) to provide an export/audit, call that out.

I'll coordinate with Sarah/Tom on the evidence they can provide; they mentioned a completed form in the first email.

Best,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@medinova.health>, Tom Ng <tng@medinova.health>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Temporary keep needed — investigation open

Marissa, team —

Legal review (quick summary): the DPA covers "preservation for legal or regulatory proceedings" under section 6.3; we can implement a temporary hold but we need:
1) explicit written request from the customer's legal/compliance team (we have the form but confirm the signatory; Tom's cc helps).
2) scope: exact dataset IDs and retention window (Sarah provided these — good).
3) evidence traceability: we should capture receipts from any subprocessors involved in snapshot management (CloudVault is listed in their onboarding).

Recommendation:
- Place an immediate 14-day hold by default while legal engages. This is a short, defined window that avoids indefinite retention. If Medinova requests an extension, Legal will require a written justification and exec escalation.
- Ops should produce an attachments list (filenames, snapshot IDs) and a minimal evidence bundle: snapshot manifest, subproc receipts (vendor attestation), and a CSV mapping user IDs -> snapshot IDs.

I'll attach a quick checklist for temp holds (legal_checklist_temp-hold.docx). Karthik, if this event affects billing/credits we should compute prorated impacts and include in the escalation pack.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: legal_checklist_temp-hold.docx (DOCX, 58 KB)
